description: fireexposuR is an R package for calculating potential wildfire transmission toward or away from a location from surrounding fuel patterns. The JOSS paper describes neighbourhood-to-national scales and outputs for fuel management, evacuation and land-use planning. Its own repository identifies GPL-3.0 terms, so the code is free. Inputs are fuel or vegetation maps and target places; outputs are numeric exposure ratings and maps. Spatial extent and resolution follow input maps and analysis settings. Infrastructure modellers could use the ratings as one layer when screening buildings, substations or roads for wildfire exposure. A caveat is that the rating reflects fuel arrangement, not a complete fire-spread forecast with weather, ignition and suppression. Input classification errors and scale choice can change priorities. No directly related catalogue record was confirmed. The package was not run and no fuel data were obtained.
